took place in a town by the coast, surrounded by hills. There was a cemetery, which was a small space enclosed by gates. When the match began, the cemetery gates opened. In the cemetery, there were many tombstones, small buildings, scarecrows and a church. Mounds can be seen around the map, where cliff towers can be placed on. A stone bridge can be seen crossing the ravine; some crashed cars could be seen near the start of the bridge. Several residential houses can be seen on the other side of the bridge. There was also a giant clock tower. On one side of the map was a railroad bridge over the coast in which a ghost train appeared on wave 10. A wooden bridge also spans part of the coast.

The stone path began in a cave surrounded by a forcefield wall in the cemetery. The path circled around a central mound then around another larger mound. It then used the bridge to cross the ravine to reach the other side. The path eventually ended at a cave, near to where the houses were.
